rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via name + zip, then updated the default address. However, it did not obtain explicit confirmation before performing the profile address change, which policy requires. More importantly, the user explicitly asked to update “all possible order addresses,” but the agent neither reviewed the user’s orders nor attempted or confirmed any order address updates. When the user asked to revert, the agent reasonably requested the full original address and declined to proceed without it, which aligns with constraints. Final state information was accurate. Overall, missing explicit pre-write confirmation and failure to act on the order address updates cause the interaction to fail the pass bar.
